Create alloflow-print-job/1 ticket

The ticket includes a deterministic SHA-256 digest of its normalized payload, excluding the integrity field. It can reveal later edits, but it is not a signature, authenticity proof, staff authorization, or server approval. It contains no commands, credentials, account identifier, or student identifier and does not authorize a physical print.
